description: Updatable Model Dialect & Pricing Registry for Mac Studio AI Orchestrator (PromptForge Engine).

claude-haiku.name: Claude Haiku 4.5 (Fast Triage & Budget)
best_practices: Wrap distinct sections in semantic XML tags (<context>, <constraints>, <task>, <output_contract>).
Place static reference files and rules at the very top so Anthropic prompt caching discounts input tokens by 90%.
Use Chain of Draft (<=5 words per step in <draft>) to keep output fast and inexpensive.
anti_patterns: Avoid deeply nested or ambiguous prose instructions without examples.
Do not mix static reference context after the dynamic user question (breaks prefix cache).

claude-sonnet.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Standard Coding & Execution)
best_practices: Use explicit XML tags (<role>, <static_context>, <verification_gates>, <constraints>, <task>, <output_contract>).
State explicit scope boundaries (which files to touch and which not to touch) to prevent over-engineering.
Include a 1-line <self_check> rubric so the model verifies edge cases before emitting final code.
anti_patterns: Avoid open-ended 'make this better' prompts without acceptance criteria.
Avoid verbose step-by-step narration when only code or structured JSON is needed.

claude-opus-thinking.name: Claude Opus (High Effort / Extended Thinking)
best_practices: Provide crystal-clear end-state invariants, architectural constraints, and verification gates in XML tags.
Let native high-effort thinking handle decomposition—strip manual 'think step by step' instructions.
Reserve for complex architecture, concurrency bugs, and security audits.
anti_patterns: Never inject manual Chain-of-Thought prompts (causes redundant double-reasoning and inflates output cost).
Do not use for routine single-file edits or simple boilerplate where Sonnet or Flash is 5x-20x cheaper.

gemini-flash.name: Gemini Flash (UI Inspection, Fast Multimodal & Budget)
best_practices: Use clear Markdown headings (###) and bulleted checklists.
Place large documents, logs, or multimodal context first, followed by a concise task instruction at the very end.
Ideal for high-volume tasks, DOM/UI inspection, and fast summarization.
anti_patterns: Avoid burying the core question at the top of a massive context block.

gemini-argon-pro.name: Gemini 4 Argon (Multi-File Scaffolding & Multimodal Pro)
best_practices: Structure prompts with explicit Markdown sections: ### Role, ### Static Context & Gates, ### Constraints, ### Task, ### Output Contract.
Include explicit negative constraints (what NOT to do) to keep multi-file scaffolding tight.
Leverage Gemini's massive context window for >5-file boilerplate and media/PDF analysis.
anti_patterns: Avoid mixing unrelated subtasks in a single unnumbered paragraph.

gemini-thinking.name: Gemini 4 Argon High (Deep Reasoning Mode)
best_practices: Define clear goal states, edge-case constraints, and verification gates without prescribing manual reasoning steps.
Place all repository context above the final task directive.
anti_patterns: Do not force verbose manual Chain-of-Thought when High reasoning effort is already active.

gpt-4o-mini.name: OpenAI GPT-4o Mini (Budget API Tier)
best_practices: Keep static instructions >1,024 tokens at the very start to trigger automatic OpenAI prefix caching (50% discount).
Specify strict JSON or Markdown output schemas.
anti_patterns: Avoid complex multi-hop reasoning without Chain-of-Draft steps.

gpt-4o.name: OpenAI GPT-4o (Standard API Tier)
best_practices: Separate permanent Developer/System rules from dynamic User task payloads.
Use Chain of Draft to cut output token latency and cost by up to 65%.
anti_patterns: Avoid placing dynamic timestamps or changing variables at the top of the prompt (invalidates prefix cache).

o3-reasoning.name: OpenAI o3 / Reasoning (Frontier Reasoning Tier)
best_practices: Keep prompts direct and specification-driven: state what the final solution must satisfy.
Omit 'think step by step'—reasoning models perform internal search automatically.
anti_patterns: Never prompt with manual Chain-of-Thought instructions on o-series reasoning models.
